where.title: Where your data lives
where.database: The database is in Ireland (Convex, AWS eu-west-1). It holds everything except the files.
where.pdfs: Files (PDFs, photos and emails with their attachments) are stored in Cloudflare R2 with EU jurisdiction.
where.reading: Reading happens with Vertex AI, in Google Cloud's EU multi-region.
where.us: Matching the read text to your Fields happens at TypeSafe in the United States, sign-in emails go through Resend in the United States, and payments go through Stripe in the United States. See <link>Who processes it</link>.

retention.title: How long we keep it, and deletion
retention.default: 30 days after sending by default. Your Admin can set anywhere from 1 to 365 days.
retention.neverApproved: Submissions never approved are deleted 90 days after upload.
retention.rejected: Rejected Submissions are deleted 30 days after rejection.
retention.proposals: Unsaved Form Proposals are deleted after 7 days, with their sample file.
retention.what: Deletion removes the file, what Vink read, all values and the Payload.
retention.kept: We keep a short record (file name, who uploaded and approved it, dates, delivery status), never the file or its values.
retention.now: An Admin can delete any Submission right away, approved ones included. Pending retries for it are cancelled.
retention.account: You delete your account yourself from the account menu. An Admin deletes the Organisation under Settings, in the Danger Zone. Everything is then gone at once.

subprocessors.title: Subprocessors
subprocessors.intro: Every party that handles your data, what for, where, and what it receives.
subprocessors.name: Name

cloudflare.purpose: Proxy and protection for the site and the app

r2.data: PDFs, photos and emails with their attachments

typesafe.purpose: Matching read text to your Fields
typesafe.data: The read text. May keep logs under <link>its own terms</link>.

resend.purpose: Emails from Vink: sign-in, invitations, plan and notices

email.purpose: Receiving emails sent to an Intake Address
email.data: Emails sent to an Intake Address, with their attachments

stripe.data: Your organisation's name and ID, the payer's email address, and the billing address, VAT number and payment details you enter at Stripe. Partly a controller itself, under <link>its own privacy policy</link>.

subprocessors.transfers: Transfers to the United States rely on the EU–US Data Privacy Framework or Standard Contractual Clauses.

access.title: Access and accounts
access.isolation: Each Organisation only sees its own data. Every request is checked against a Membership, and this is covered by automated tests.
access.roles: There are two roles, Admin and Member. Only Admins can:

admin.members: invite and remove members, and change roles
admin.forms: create and change Forms, including Auto-Send and the Review Threshold
admin.integrations: add, change and remove Integrations, and see their secrets
admin.retention: change the Organisation's name and retention period
admin.delete: delete Submissions and send failed Deliveries again

access.autoSend: Auto-Send is off by default. An Admin turns it on per Form, and it only sends Submissions with no unsure values.
access.signIn: Sign-in is by email link, which expires after 5 minutes, or by password. Sessions last 7 days.

transit.title: In transit and at rest
transit.links: Links to a file expire after 5 minutes.
transit.secrets: Integration secrets are encrypted (AES-256-GCM) with a key kept outside the database.
transit.rest: Data at rest is encrypted by the providers.
transit.signed: Payloads are signed with HMAC-SHA256, with one secret per Integration and a timestamp against replays. See <link>Verify the signature</link>.
transit.testSend: A test-send only sends example values or an approved Submission.

notYet.title: What we don't have yet
notYet.certs: No SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certification yet.
notYet.twoFactor: No two-factor sign-in or SSO yet.
notYet.dpa: No separate data processing agreement to sign yet. The processing terms are part of these terms, under Processing personal data.

report.title: Reporting a problem and contact
report.body: Found a security problem? Email <email></email>. We read every report and reply to you directly. Our <securityTxt>security.txt</securityTxt> has the same details.
report.other: Questions about privacy, or need the DPA? <link>Contact us</link>.
